title: Hold the Gate
rule: Slay the horde before it breaks the gate.
threatText: Every goblin that reaches the gate hits it.

title: Defeat the Siegebreaker
rule: Kill the Siegebreaker before he smashes the gate.

title: Goblin Rush
rule: Survive the endless rush until time runs out.
threatText: A nonstop swarm heads for the gate.

title: Free the Prisoners
rule: Break open every cage before time runs out.

title: Destroy the Siege Engines
rule: Smash the enemy catapults before time runs out.

title: Golden Goblin
rule: Catch the Golden Goblin before it escapes.

title: Protect the Supply Wagon
rule: Escort the wagon to the gate before time runs out.

title: Captain Assault
rule: Kill the clan captain to win the sector.
